hero.title: Stories That Create Opportunities
hero.description: M. Dadu Films is more than a production house. We bring filmmakers, technicians, performers and creative collaborators together to build stories with purpose — from the first idea to the final frame.
hero.imageAlt: Film production crew working on a cinematic set

story.title: A production house built around storytelling and collaboration.
paragraphs: M. Dadu Films brings together filmmakers, technicians, performers and creative collaborators to build visual stories with purpose. Our work spans narrative and commercial formats, but the approach stays consistent: understand the idea, prepare properly and give every department enough clarity to do its best work.

We believe good production is not only about what happens in front of the camera. It is the result of writing, planning, casting, cinematography, art, music, lighting, post-production and people working toward the same creative direction.

approach.title: From idea to final frame.
approach.description: A clear process keeps the creative conversation strong while production stays practical.

steps.title: Develop
steps.description: Clarify the idea, story, treatment and production path.

steps.title: Produce
steps.description: Bring the right people, planning and execution together on set.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Shape the final experience through edit, sound, colour and delivery.

vision.title: A creative ecosystem where stories and people can grow.
vision.description: To build a trusted creative ecosystem where original stories, skilled crews and emerging talent meet meaningful opportunities and can reach audiences beyond geography.

mission.title: Make strong ideas possible through thoughtful production.
mission.description: To develop and produce story-led films and branded content with strong planning, honest collaboration and disciplined execution — from the first conversation through post-production and delivery.

values.title: The values behind the work.
values.description: The format may change from project to project, but these principles stay constant.

items.title: Story First
items.description: Every decision starts with the story, the audience and the emotion the work needs to carry.

items.title: Craft & Discipline
items.description: Strong creative work needs thoughtful preparation, dependable execution and attention to the final frame.

items.title: Collaboration
items.description: Directors, technicians, artists, brands and emerging talent do their best work when the process stays open and respectful.

items.title: Opportunity
items.description: We want productions to create space for people to contribute, learn, perform and build meaningful creative work.

teamSection.title: Core Team
teamSection.description: Directors, producers and specialists working together across development, production, performance and post-production.

coreTeam.name: Yuvraj Pratap Singh
coreTeam.shortBio: Leads creative direction and production planning, helping shape projects from concept through execution.
coreTeam.details: Works across direction and producing, connecting creative intent with practical production planning. His focus is keeping a project aligned from early development through shoot execution and final delivery.

coreTeam.name: Aditya Mehta
coreTeam.shortBio: Works across direction and writing, developing story ideas into clear narratives for screen.
coreTeam.details: Works at the intersection of writing and direction, shaping narrative structure, character and screen language. His role supports translating written ideas into clear, production-ready storytelling.

coreTeam.name: Alex
coreTeam.shortBio: Shapes cinematography, camera language and visual execution to support the mood and story of each production.
coreTeam.details: Leads visual storytelling through cinematography, framing, camera movement and lighting choices. He works closely with direction and lighting teams to maintain a consistent visual language from setup to final frame.

coreTeam.name: Devendra Singh
coreTeam.shortBio: Contributes both on screen and behind the scenes, supporting production coordination and performance requirements.
coreTeam.details: Supports projects from both production and performance perspectives. His role bridges practical production needs with an actor's understanding of on-screen execution and collaboration.

coreTeam.name: Ravinder Singh
coreTeam.shortBio: Supports production planning, resources and execution so projects can move smoothly from preparation to delivery.
coreTeam.details: Focuses on production support, coordination and resource planning. He helps keep schedules, logistics and day-to-day production requirements moving in sync with the creative plan.

coreTeam.name: Shivam Chaudhary
coreTeam.shortBio: Oversees production workflows and coordination, keeping teams, schedules and project requirements aligned.
coreTeam.details: Coordinates production workflows across teams, schedules and day-to-day execution. His focus is creating a clear operating rhythm so creative and technical teams can concentrate on delivering the work.

coreTeam.name: Rahul Rasimo
coreTeam.shortBio: Works across executive production and direction, supporting creative decisions and overall project delivery.
coreTeam.details: Combines executive production oversight with directorial input, helping balance creative priorities with practical project needs. His role supports decision-making across development and execution.

coreTeam.name: Akash
coreTeam.shortBio: Shapes the visual world of productions through art direction, sets, props and design coordination.
coreTeam.details: Develops the physical visual language of a production through set ideas, props, textures and art coordination. His work helps ensure the world in front of the camera supports the tone of the story.

coreTeam.name: Shailesh Singh
coreTeam.shortBio: Contributes to the musical identity of projects through music production and vocal performance.
coreTeam.details: Works on the musical side of productions, supporting composition, production and vocal performance. His focus is helping music feel connected to the emotion and identity of the visual story.

coreTeam.name: Deepak Arya
coreTeam.shortBio: Handles digital intermediate and color finishing, helping create a consistent and polished final visual tone.
coreTeam.details: Focuses on color finishing and visual consistency in post-production. His work helps balance shots, refine mood and bring the final image closer to the intended cinematic look.

coreTeam.name: Pradeep Yadav
coreTeam.shortBio: Supports casting requirements by identifying and coordinating suitable talent for production roles.
coreTeam.details: Works with the creative and production teams to understand character requirements, identify suitable performers and coordinate the casting process from outreach through selection.

coreTeam.name: Mrityunjaya
coreTeam.shortBio: Works with camera and lighting teams to execute dependable lighting setups safely and consistently on set.
coreTeam.details: Supports the cinematography team through practical lighting execution, fixture placement and on-set adjustments. His role helps translate the lighting plan into a controlled shooting environment.

coreTeam.name: Mamvijay
coreTeam.shortBio: Contributes vocal performance to music-led and creative productions when the project calls for it.
coreTeam.details: Supports music-led productions with vocal performance and interpretation. The focus is on delivering vocals that fit the emotion, style and storytelling requirements of the project.

coreTeam.name: Sharad Chand Upadhyay
coreTeam.shortBio: Works across anchoring and voice-over, bringing clear delivery and vocal presence to screen and audio content.
coreTeam.details: Contributes spoken performance across anchoring and voice-over requirements. His role focuses on clear communication, vocal expression and adapting delivery to the tone of the production.
